title: CIC 2 Task 2
reading_title: Campus Café to Launch 24-Hour Study Lounge
question_text: The woman expresses her opinion about the student union's plan to convert the café into a 24-hour study lounge. State her opinion and explain the reasons she gives for holding that opinion.
reading_body: The student union has announced that the campus café will soon be converted into a 24-hour study lounge during exam weeks. The café will close food service at 9 p.m., but remain open overnight as a quiet, monitored space for students who prefer to study late. The university believes this change will benefit students who struggle to find quiet study areas in the evenings, especially during finals. Extra seating and charging stations will also be added.
